column1: # YR functions the tree defines under one name and calls under another (one address each, data/manifest.csv).
# yr_aliases.py adds these rows to aliases.tsv (ld64 -alias_list). alias<TAB>target (Mach-O symbols).
# TechnoClass's virtual slots 0x3D0 and 0x3E0-0x3EC (lane Y4): gamemd.exe's TechnoClass, FootClass,
# InfantryClass, UnitClass, BuildingClass and AircraftClass vtables all point them at these addresses.
# TibSun's ObjectClass::Direction is the tree's AbstractClass::GetTargetDirection (0x005F3DB0, one body; lane Y4).
# SidebarClass::Add is the tree's SidebarClass::AddCameo (0x006A6300; lane Y4).
# UnselectAll is the tree's Unselect_All (0x0048DC90; lane Y4).
# The area damage, 0x00489280, under its three names (lane Y4): combat_native.inc defines Explosion_Damage.
# The sound system master's pointer, 0x00816514 (lane Y7): audio.cpp passes DAT_00816514 to AudioLoadSystem;
# drv_dsnd.cpp defines it as AudioSystemDSD (gamemd.exe: 0x00816514 holds 0x00816358, the master named
# "Direct Sound Driver V2.0" whose load is audioLoad 0x00409470). Before, the copy from gamemd.exe held 32-bit addresses.
# TechnoClass::ScanForTiberium (vtable slot 0x338) is the tree's TechnoClass::FUN_0070F8F0 (lane Y7: gamemd.exe's
# BuildingClass vtable holds 0x0070F8F0 there; a deployed slave miner's manager scans with it; the second parameter is unused).
# Is_Speaking (vox.h; Select_Game waits on it at Exit Game with sound on) is the tree's FUN_007529E0 (lane Y8: gamemd.exe 0x007529E0
# services the speech queue and answers whether the EVA stream plays or a speech waits, as the RA2 twin 0x00715E20).
# ShapeSet::Get_Color is SHPStruct::GetColor (lane Y8: gamemd.exe calls 0x0069E860 for it, which resolves an SHPReference
# to the file behind it; lane Y3's TibSun-text draft read the reference object's own bytes as frame records: wrong radar colours
# of overlays and reads past the reference, found by guard malloc).
# ShapeSet's other frame methods are SHPStruct's too (lane Y8; hdr/shapeset.h fixup: gamemd.exe calls these where the tree has inlines).
# TechnoClass::Destroy (ObjectClass vtable slot 0x170) is the tree's TechnoClass::FUN_00710460 (lane Y11: gamemd.exe's TechnoClass,
# FootClass, BuildingClass, InfantryClass and AircraftClass vtables hold 0x00710460 there, UnitClass::Destroy calls it; it frees
# the mind-controlled units. A unit dying while mind-controlling reached the trap in a long skirmish under ctest -j4).
# HouseClass::Is_Build_Limited is the tree's HouseClass::FUN_0050B370 (lane Y11b: FactoryClass::Set 0x004C9C70 calls 0x0050B370
# where the tree calls Is_Build_Limited; a second unit queued in a factory reached the trap).
# HouseClass::MindControlBuildings and RelinquishBuildings are the tree's FUN_0050D290 and FUN_0050D2D0 (lane Y11b: the trigger
# actions 0x006E0CA0 and 0x006E0D00 call them where the tree has those names).
# CellClass::On_Ground (AbstractClass vtable slot 20) is the tree's CellClass::Is_Tile_Not_Water (lane Y12: gamemd.exe's CellClass vtable
# 0x007E4EEC holds 0x004867E0 at slot 20, the folded body of both; reached when a unit attacks another and checks its target on the ground).
# FUN_004C3E30 (the main menu's Credits, init.cpp) is Show_Who_Was_Responsible (lane Y12: gamemd.exe's Do_Win 0x006859EE calls 0x004C3E30
# after a campaign's final movie; glue/egos_native.inc).
# Submit_Radar_Event (revent.h; TAction RADAR_EVENT, TechnoClass::Update_Radar_Position) is RadarEventClass::Create, gamemd.exe 0x0065FA70
# (lane Y12: the tree defines it as the static member and declares the free function too).
# FUN_00622B50 (stlscore.cpp: the campaign score screen's dialog procedure passes the rest on to it) is UI::StandardWndProc, gamemd.exe 0x00622B50 (lane Y12).
# FUN_005BF390 (taction.cpp: the in-game movie actions) is Play_Ingame_Movie(VQType, bool), gamemd.exe 0x005BF390 (lane Y12, the campaign chain reached it).
# FUN_0041C610 (init.cpp Delete_All_Objects: the qsort compare of the object index) is IndexClass<int, AbstractClass *>::search_compfunc, gamemd.exe 0x0041C610 (lane Y12).

# Bit_Stuff / Bit_Unstuff_String (bfiofile2.cpp, gamemd.exe 0x004335E0 / 0x00433770) as wstring.cpp declares them (wide source, char buffers; lane YW, the LAN names): one function each, the parameters pointers and ints either way.
# Build_Number (winstub.h) is FUN_00777B50 (winstub.cpp, gamemd.exe 0x00777B50: the build number DAT_00822D1C), lane YW: the network packets carry it.
# OwnerDraw::Draw_Dialog_Back (netshare.cpp ODMessageBox_Proc, queue.cpp, worlddom.cpp) is OwnerDraw::Paint: gamemd.exe 0x005E2E64 calls 0x00621E90 there (lane YW, the network message box).
# TechnoClass::GotHijacked is TechnoClass vtable slot 0x2E0, which gamemd.exe fills with 0x0070D980, the tree's (empty)
# TechnoClass::Scatter_Incoming_Infantry; BuildingClass's override 0x004576F0 scatters the infantry heading into it (lane Y14).
# BuildingClass::Spied_By (the TibSun-text Per_Cell_Process draft's spy entry) is gamemd.exe's BuildingClass::Infiltrate,
# BuildingClass::Power_Off (called by Turn_Off, 0x00452360) is gamemd.exe 0x00452480, the tree's BuildingClass::DisableStuff (lane Y14).
